title: Grateful Dead Live at International Amphitheatre on 1973-02-19
lineage: SBD : MC > C > DAT > SS > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard source with a few muddy drop‑outs captures an unforgettable 2/19/73 second set, highlighted by the legendary He's Gone → Truckin' → Other One → Eyes of the World → China Doll marathon.
ai_review.review: The recording is mostly clear and well‑balanced for a 1973 soundboard tape, though listeners note a muddy start to the “Eyes” segment and occasional drop‑outs. Musically the show shines – fans rave about the sprawling jam that stitches He’s Gone, Truckin’, The Other One, Eyes of the World and China Doll together, plus strong outings of Sugar Magnolia, Casey Jones and a hot “Other One”. Overall the performance is considered one of the top second‑sets of ’73.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and praise the show’s jams; recording is generally praised with only minor sound‑quality complaints, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and crisp for a vintage board tape. Early part of the “Eyes” jam is described as muddy with occasional drop‑outs; otherwise sound is solid.

standout_songs: He's Gone → Truckin' → The Other One → Eyes of the World → China Doll
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is praised as one of ’73’s best, with seamless transitions through a massive jammed suite; despite being a partial recording it maintains an exciting, cohesive flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work on the extended jam (especially closing ‘Eyes’ into China Doll) is highlighted as stellar.
band_member_comments.Phil: Multiple reviewers call Phil’s bass solos and licks among his best of the year, noting a “Leshophile” highlight.
